title: NFT Metadata Validator
description: Validates NFT metadata against ERC-721 and ERC-1155 required fields plus OpenSea metadata schema recommendations. Checks required fields (name, description, image), recommended fields (external_url, animation_url, attributes), and license declaration. Returns grouped pass/fail results. Not legal advice.
